goal: Analyze Belize's multilingual identity (English, Spanish, Kriol, Garifuna, Maya), barrier reef ecosystems, and border litigation with Guatemala.

sections.title: Unit 9: The Guianas & Belize — Lesson 1
body: Welcome to lesson 1 of Unit 9 in the Latin American Regional Studies track: Belize, Suriname & The Guianas: Multilingual Frontiers.
In this lesson, we study belice: encrucijada maya, arrecifes de coral y herencia garífuna, evaluating physical geomorphology, maroon resistance, linguistic pluralism, and geopolitics.

items: Analyze Belize's multilingual identity (English, Spanish, Kriol, Garifuna, Maya), barrier reef ecosystems, and border litigation with Guatemala.
Master the lexicon and discourse of belice-multilinguismo-garifuna.
